name: turn-undead-cotw-contracts
description: Turn Undead beside Call of the Wild alone (the lab snapshot's installed 1.14.4c): the product's completion line must report CotW present without a drift warning, and the harness contracts mode records the installed method IL hashes, the native and constructed Turn blueprint values, the CotW positive-harm channel entries with their Turn Undead support status, and each source's menu child placement under its own positive-harm wrapper with the direct action hidden. Setup is disclosed in tools/LoaderCompatHarness/TurnUndeadContractProbes.cs. A second step drives the product adapter through its failure boundary with substitute engine types: after the live publication is rolled back, a drift engine (valid improved_channel, missing sacred_conduit) must leave menu, visibility and lists exactly as before; an optional-null holder and an already-populated second publication must behave; re-publication must equal the original; removed or swapped menu children must fail the independent placement checker.
